item.title: Fri 13 Nov: Inflation breaks the RBI's 6% ceiling
item.description:
Hot topic: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, breaking the RBI's 6% ceiling just after rate-sensitive stocks rallied. Then: banks, the rupee, realty, Bajaj Finance, Nvidia, oil, Brent, US yields and gold.
1. India's retail inflation rises to 6.09% in October, a 24-month high above the RBI's 6% ceiling (ThePrint (PTI)) 2. Banks lead for a fourth session as Nifty Bank rises 1.2% and PSU lenders gain 1.4% (HDFC Sky; Yahoo Finance) 3. Rupee falls 34 paise to 94.03 per dollar as the dollar index hits its highest since April 2025 (HDFC Sky; Yahoo Finance) 4. Realty jumps 4.5% to lead the market just before the 6% inflation print (Yahoo Finance; The Open Press) 5. Bajaj Finance jumps 3.4% as NBFCs lead the Nifty (Business Standard; HDFC Sky) 6. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; shares fall 4.3% as AMD and Broadcom gain more than 5% (WPTF (AP); TheStreet) 7. Oil reverses higher on Gulf attacks after peace-talk hopes; Reliance edges up (Reuters via Nation Thailand; Yahoo Finance) 8. Brent jumps 3.3% to 95.82 dollars as Houthis strike Saudi energy sites and Trump drops Iran deal talks (Reuters via Nation Thailand) 9. US 10-year jumps back above 5% to 5.10% as Fed officials push for more hikes (Yahoo Finance; CNBC; TheStreet) 10. Gold drops 2.2% below 3,950 dollars as the dollar hits a 19-month high (Yahoo Finance; Business Standard)
From the Ripple news desk. Voices are AI-generated with open-source Kokoro voices. This is news, not investment advice; the hosts are not SEBI-registered advisers.

item.title: Thu 12 Nov: Foreign money lifts Nifty to nine-month high
item.description:
Hot topic: foreign money pushed the Nifty to a nine-month high, but Gift Nifty points lower after an overnight Nvidia shock, with India's inflation print due today. Then: banks, Tata Power, the rupee, oil, US yields, IT, CPI, IndiGo and gold.
1. Nifty climbs 0.84% to 25,255, a nine-month high, as November foreign buying tops 5.6 billion dollars (Upstox; Business Standard) 2. Nifty Bank rises 1.76% to 60,792 as PSU lenders jump 2.9% for a third day of bank leadership (Liquide; Upstox) 3. Tata Power's September-quarter profit rises 49% to 1,366 crore rupees as revenue climbs 26% (Upstox; Free Press Journal) 4. Rupee firms to 93.69 per dollar, its strongest since April, on foreign equity inflows (Business Today) 5. Brent rebounds to about 93 dollars as Hormuz tanker attacks continue; Goldman lifts its December forecast to 105 dollars (Business Recorder; HDFC Sky) 6. US 10-year yield returns to 5% after hotter October inflation and Waller's hawkish comments (CBS News; Saxo) 7. IT stocks lag again as Nifty IT slips 0.5% while banks and autos rally (Liquide; Yahoo Finance) 8. India's October inflation, due today, is expected near 6%, the top of the RBI's band (Business Today; Mint via TradingView) 9. IndiGo jumps 4.3% to 5,665 rupees as airlines rally on the dip in crude (Business Standard; Kotak Neo) 10. Gold slips below 4,000 dollars an ounce after the hot US inflation print (Kitco; Investing.com)

item.title: Mon 9 Nov: Nifty reclaims 25,000 on record foreign buying
item.description:
Hot topic: the Nifty reclaimed 25,000 with a seventh straight gain on a record week of foreign buying, ahead of the first full session of Samvat 2083. Then: banks, Tata Steel, Hindalco, the rupee, oil, US jobs, IT, Titan and M&M.
1. Nifty reclaims 25,000 with a seventh straight gain as banks lead and India shrugs off the US chip rout (5paisa; INDIA IPO (Mint)) 2. Nifty Bank jumps 2.3% to 59,086 as ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank lead for a second day (5paisa; Kotak Neo) 3. Tata Steel's September-quarter profit rises 18.2% to 3,666 crore rupees; Nuvama upgrades the stock (Business Today) 4. Hindalco's profit jumps 59% to 7,532 crore rupees as revenue rises 39% (Business Today) 5. Rupee rallies 52 paise to 93.89, its best day in weeks, as the equity surge draws dollars (Telangana Today (PTI); Tapetide; Cappnotes) 6. Brent holds near 98 dollars as Gulf tanker attacks keep a floor under oil (Reuters via Global Banking & Finance) 7. US payrolls beat at 165,000 as the 10-year yield rises to 4.86% (Cappnotes; The Closing Print) 8. Indian IT lags the rally as Nifty IT rises only 0.4% while money moves into banks (5paisa; INDIA IPO (Mint); Cappnotes) 9. Titan hits 5,000 rupees on Dhanteras, up about 10% in three sessions after its results (5paisa; INDIA IPO) 10. M&M extends its post-results rally, rising another 5% to 3,287 rupees (5paisa; INDIA IPO (Mint))

item.title: Week Ahead, Sun 8 Nov: Tata Steel's profit rises 18% on India margins
item.description:
Hot topic: Tata Steel's profit rose 18% as Indian steel margins hit 25%, but the UK still loses money and net debt is up. Then: Muhurat trading, Hormuz, Korea's chip rout, Divi's Labs, US CPI, data-centre ballots, Saudi crude, Nifty valuations and Tata Chemicals.
1. Tata Steel's profit rises 18% to 3,666 crore rupees as India margins hit 25%, while the UK still loses money (Business Standard) 2. Muhurat trading runs 2:20-3:30 pm today, the first session of Samvat 2083, after seven straight Nifty gains (Business Today) 3. Qatar floats a plan to reopen Hormuz as Trump confirms 'minor strikes' on Iran's Qeshm Island (The Independent (via Yahoo)) 4. Korea suspends its margin-collateral rule for three months after the Kospi's 11.7% weekly plunge (Seoul Economic Daily) 5. Divi's Labs' profit jumps 64% to 1,127 crore rupees as revenue rises about 35% (Investywise (filing summary)) 6. US CPI on Tuesday is the next test after payrolls lift December Fed hike odds above 76% (Trading Economics) 7. US voters back data-centre limits in 40 of 41 local ballots, adding a policy risk to the AI build-out (AI Weekly) 8. Saudi Arabia cuts its Asian crude prices to a six-year low as Gulf shipments resume (Rigzone) 9. Brokers urge caution after last week's rally as Motilal Oswal puts the Nifty at 17.5 times forward earnings (Business Today) 10. Tata Chemicals swings to a September-quarter loss on weaker margins despite 7.7% revenue growth (Sahi)

item.title: Week in Ripples, Sat 7 Nov: Nifty's best week since February 2021
item.description:
Hot topic: the Nifty and Sensex posted their best week since February 2021 as a seven-session rally lifted the Nifty above 25,000 on record foreign buying. Then: foreign flows, US payrolls, Asia's chip crash, oil, Wall Street, the rupee, Tata Steel, Hindalco and Muhurat trading.
1. Sensex and Nifty post their best week since February 2021 as a seven-session rally lifts the Nifty above 25,000 (Business Standard) 2. Foreign investors buy a record 45,960 crore rupees of Indian shares in a week as domestic funds sell a record 24,197 crore rupees (Business Standard) 3. US payrolls jump 165,000 in October, nearly triple forecasts, lifting December Fed hike odds to about 77-85% (Yahoo Finance (Reuters)) 4. Asian chip stocks crash: Kospi halted after an 8% fall, Nikkei drops about 6%, SK Hynix falls 11.7% (Yahoo Finance (Fox Business)) 5. Oil posts its biggest weekly drop since 2022 on Iran peace hopes, with Brent settling flat at 98.32 dollars (Rigzone (Bloomberg)) 6. Wall Street steadies: Nasdaq gains 1.1% as AMD jumps 11%, but the S&P 500 still loses 2.7% for the week (Yahoo Finance (AP)) 7. Rupee logs its biggest one-day gain since 12 October, closing at about 93.9 per dollar (IANS) 8. Tata Steel reports delayed September-quarter results on Saturday, alongside Divi's Labs, Tata Chemicals and HBL Engineering (PSU Connect) 9. Hindalco's profit jumps 59% to 7,533 crore rupees as revenue rises 39% to 91,708 crore rupees (Kotak Neo) 10. Diwali Muhurat trading runs on Sunday 8 Nov in a rare afternoon slot; markets shut on Tuesday 10 Nov (Outlook Money)

item.title: Fri 6 Nov: Nifty's sixth straight gain meets a Wall Street rout
item.description:
Hot topic: the Nifty rose for a sixth straight day on record foreign buying, then Wall Street had its worst day since April 2025. Then: Airtel, Titan, ONGC, oil, the rupee, US payrolls, foreign flows, IT and IndiGo.
1. Nifty jumps 2.4% to 24,537 for a sixth straight gain as foreign investors buy 14,975 crore rupees (Business Today) 2. Bharti Airtel's ARPU climbs to 271 rupees, but profit of 8,888 crore rupees misses estimates (Upstox) 3. Titan's jewellery sales grow 24%; board approves 2,500 crore rupees of NCDs (Upstox) 4. ONGC's standalone profit jumps 57% to 15,489 crore rupees; record 8 rupee interim dividend (Upstox) 5. Brent rebounds 3.88% to 98.29 dollars as Iran peace remains unconfirmed (Reuters via Yahoo Finance) 6. Rupee ends flat at 94.46 as foreign inflows offset a firmer dollar (HDFC Sky (PTI)) 7. US payrolls are the next test after Treasury yields slide to their lowest since September (Stock Titan) 8. Foreign investors buy a net 14,975 crore rupees, a fifth straight day, as banks lead the rally (NiftyTrader) 9. IT stocks rebound 2.4% even as the Nasdaq slides on AI-regulation worries (Stock Titan) 10. IndiGo and Asian Paints jump 4-5% as the oil slide lifts fuel-sensitive stocks (DSIJ)

item.title: Thu 5 Nov: Nifty's fifth straight gain as Democrats win Congress
item.description:
Hot topic: the Nifty rose for a fifth straight day to a two-month closing high as Democrats swept Congress, and GIFT Nifty points to a gap-up. Then: IT, the rupee, oil, US yields, Airtel, Titan, HDFC Bank, ONGC and Dabur.
1. Nifty gains for a fifth day to a two-month closing high of 23,961 as Democrats win Congress (Upstox; HDFC Sky; Kotak Neo) 2. IT stocks fall 1.5% as investors weigh what a Democratic Congress means for AI spending (Upstox; Yahoo Finance (Investopedia); TradingKey) 3. Rupee firms for a fourth day to 94.64 as the dollar slips after the US midterms (HDFC Sky; CappNotes; 5paisa) 4. Brent settles 8.7% lower at 94.62 dollars as the Democratic sweep trims the war premium (Rigzone (Bloomberg); Al Jazeera) 5. US 10-year Treasury yield falls about 6 bp to 4.89% as Democrats sweep Congress (CappNotes; Finwire; Seeking Alpha) 6. Bharti Airtel reports September-quarter results; brokerages expect 14-15% revenue growth and ARPU near 268 rupees (Business Standard) 7. Titan jumps 4.2% ahead of Dhanteras and its September-quarter results on 5 Nov (Upstox; Kotak Neo; Bloomingbit (Reuters)) 8. HDFC Bank extends its run as foreign buying lifts private lenders (5paisa; Liquide; Yahoo Finance) 9. ONGC's board meets on 5 Nov for results and an interim dividend as Brent slides (PSU Connect; Rigzone (Bloomberg); Dimsum Daily) 10. Dabur's profit rises 12% to 506 crore rupees on 5.5% volume growth, but margins slip (Business Today)
